JL he eight of us were waiting patiently, looking at the empty

the era of luxury railroad

Lehigh Black Dia

road in 1916 and served as a "mansion on rails" for raihoad
executives and financiers until its retirement after sixty years
of use. The car was purchased a few years ago, and lovingly
restored by Richard A. Horstmann, Pi '57. Dick, who is the
Chairman of Psi Upsilon's Alumni Advisory Board, and a mem
ber of the Executive Council, fi-equently charters the car for
trips all around the United States. We were particularly priv
ileged to have him serve as our host for this very special trip.
It was a lifetime dream of Dick's to have such a car, and his
love for rail travel is apparent when you see him on board the
"353."
